name: chrome-music-lab
description: Chrome Music Lab unified project for Vercel

scripts.build:webpack: WP=$(pwd)/arpeggios/node_modules/.bin/webpack; ROOT_NM=$(pwd)/arpeggios/node_modules; for dir in arpeggios chords melodymaker pianoroll soundspinner; do echo "Building $dir..."; (cd "$dir" && NODE_PATH="$(pwd)/node_modules:$(pwd)/../arpeggios/node_modules:$(pwd)/../pianoroll/node_modules:$(pwd)/../soundspinner/node_modules:$ROOT_NM" "$WP" --config webpack.config.js); done
scripts.build: npm run build:webpack && npm run build:spectrogram
